My article on the interplay between the Antimonopoly Act and blockchain appeared in *NBL* no. 1252.

The piece focuses on introducing the ideas and background of the technology that I thought should be taken into account when discussing blockchain in relation to antimonopoly law. So its style differs a little from my usual articles and its content is abstract, but I love this kind of topic and had a great time writing it.
